boundary: Operational and synthetic workflow evidence only; failed witnesses remain retained and same-owner passing witnesses are not independent reproduction.

records.failed_witness: The first skill-inventory PowerShell projection piped directly after a foreach block and failed parser validation.
records.passing_witness: All fourteen required skill entrypoints and ordered references were then hashed and read through EOF.
records.recovery: Materialize the inventory array before projecting bounded fields.
records.recurrence_guard: Do not pipe directly from a parenthesized native or foreach construction in Windows PowerShell.
records.rollback: The parser failure occurred before any repository mutation.
records.sibling_recommendation: Materialize bounded arrays before projections.

records.failed_witness: Installed authorization and roster state validated structurally but its cursor stopped at Lyren v662-v5.
records.passing_witness: The exact-head route receipt and live authorization agree that Caelen is current and Orin is terminally gated next.
records.recovery: Treat it as structural context and use exact-head Sable route snapshots plus the newest live activation for current authority.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep schema validity separate from current route freshness.
records.rollback: No global state or roster file was changed.
records.sibling_recommendation: Record stale-but-valid control state without promoting it.

records.failed_witness: A combined read of several source receipts and the source-to-evidence manifest exceeded the bounded output projection.
records.passing_witness: The 95-entry final manifest was checked against every exact Git blob, byte count, SHA-256, commitment and Merkle root.
records.recovery: Read scalar receipt fields and verify exact Git commitments without dumping arrays.
records.recurrence_guard: Use commitments and bounded summaries for large manifests.
records.rollback: The truncated read changed no file and earned zero verification credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer scalar manifest proof over large console dumps.

records.failed_witness: A broad external canonical-receipt projection exceeded the model output budget.
records.passing_witness: The receipt file digest and canonical payload digest exactly matched the activation and the one-success/no-replay fields were true.
records.recovery: Inspect exact keys and scalar sections, then recompute the canonical payload digest.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect receipt keys before selecting bounded fields.
records.rollback: The projection changed no repository or receipt.
records.sibling_recommendation: Never replay a successful canonical run to improve presentation.

records.failed_witness: The first all-chain keyword projection used the Windows legacy stdout codec and failed on a Māori character.
records.passing_witness: The corrected projection reconstructed exactly 3670 proposal labels and preserved Unicode text.
records.recovery: Set process-local PYTHONIOENCODING to UTF-8 and rerun only the read-only projection.
records.recurrence_guard: Declare UTF-8 explicitly for Windows JSON projections containing Māori text.
records.rollback: No repository file was written by either projection.
records.sibling_recommendation: Make output encoding explicit before broad text audits.

records.failed_witness: A SequenceMatcher all-pairs semantic audit exceeded the bounded startup target.
records.passing_witness: The recovered audit found no exact collision for the twenty cave-survey proposals and exposed the highest structural neighbours for review.
records.recovery: Replace full pairwise sequence comparison with normalized token indexing and bounded Jaccard neighbours.
records.recurrence_guard: Use indexed token similarity after an explicit small-corpus benchmark.
records.rollback: The slow read-only process was stopped without repository mutation.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use token indexing rather than all-pairs sequence matching.

records.failed_witness: The first branch-collision PowerShell expression embedded a native command and status capture inside parentheses and failed parser validation.
records.passing_witness: The corrected probe proved the local branch and target path absent while the source remained exact and clean.
records.recovery: Run the Git probe separately, capture LASTEXITCODE, then build the scalar result.
records.recurrence_guard: Separate native commands from PowerShell object construction.
records.rollback: The parser stopped before branch or worktree creation.
records.sibling_recommendation: Keep native Git calls as standalone statements.

records.failed_witness: The first absent-remote-branch projection called Trim on a null result.
records.passing_witness: The corrected fresh live query returned exit zero and an empty exact branch match.
records.recovery: Materialize the ls-remote output as an array, join it, then trim the scalar.
records.recurrence_guard: Treat empty native output as an empty array rather than a string.
records.rollback: The failed read-only projection created no branch and changed no remote.
records.sibling_recommendation: Normalize empty native output before string methods.

records.failed_witness: The first x1 writer requested Pacific/Auckland from Python zoneinfo, but the installed runtime had no tzdata package and stopped before writing a tracked file.
records.passing_witness: The recovered writer created the bounded x1 records without installing software or changing the host clock.
records.recovery: Use the already-configured host Auckland clock from PowerShell and pass sanitized ISO timestamps process-locally.
records.recurrence_guard: Use the host timezone on this Windows runtime unless tzdata is already present.
records.rollback: Only an empty untracked directory was created; no tracked content or Git state changed.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not install timezone data solely to render a phase timestamp.

records.failed_witness: The first workflow-refinement packet validator was pointed at a single valid runner output, but the validator requires a paired raw-audit, normalized-pass and Method Flow preparation packet.
records.passing_witness: The sanitized Caelen-to-Orin workflow refinement itself passed twenty of twenty policy checks with zero issues and no confirmation requirement.
records.recovery: Keep the failed invocation at zero credit and use the refinement runner's own valid twenty-check receipt for this bounded plan rather than fabricating the absent paired packet.
records.recurrence_guard: Use the final packet validator only when the full fail-pass preparation packet described by its contract exists.
records.rollback: The validator wrote no receipt, changed no repository file and did not alter the valid external refinement output.
records.sibling_recommendation: Distinguish the workflow runner receipt from the optional full preparation-packet validator contract.

records.failed_witness: The first targeted patch retry invoked the shell wrapper for apply_patch from the D-drive worktree and Windows denied execution.
records.passing_witness: The direct patch tool updated only the intended x1 scalar fields without touching any sibling or shared file.
records.recovery: Use the provided apply_patch tool directly with the exact absolute file target.
records.recurrence_guard: Use the native patch tool rather than its ephemeral shell wrapper for cross-drive edits.
records.rollback: The denied wrapper changed no file; the successful patch remains visible as an exact additive diff.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer the provided patch tool for precise cross-drive edits.

records.recovery: Inspect written artifacts with bounded scalar projections before deciding whether any component requires regeneration; do not rerun a successful writer merely because its console projection was truncated.
records.recurrence_guard: Separate artifact generation from compact scalar inspection and cap every command-output projection.
records.rollback: Give the truncated projection zero credit, retain the written artifacts only after independent structural inspection, and preserve immutable x1 and all sibling lanes.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use bounded post-write scalar inspection whenever a successful writer can emit output larger than the command transport budget.

records.failed_witness: The first phase-local skill smoke harness required every generated smoke receipt entrypoint to equal SKILL.md, although the receipts correctly name their bounded toolkit command.
records.passing_witness: Direct receipt inspection established the actual bounded command contract and the later corrected smoke sequence exercised it successfully without treating the false negative as skill completion evidence.
records.recovery: Inspect one generated smoke receipt before asserting its schema values, then validate every receipt against the discovered exact contract.
records.recurrence_guard: Derive smoke-harness expectations from the committed phase-local schema rather than an assumed generic skill layout.
records.rollback: Give the failed harness zero credit and leave every generated skill and sibling lane unchanged.
records.sibling_recommendation: Probe one representative phase-local smoke receipt before constructing a multi-skill assertion.

records.recovery: Normalize Markdown whitespace for semantic command matching while retaining exact JSON receipt comparison.
records.recurrence_guard: Use whitespace-insensitive checks for prose-wrapped commands and never couple line wrapping to contract validity.
records.rollback: Give the false-negative static harness zero credit, retain the successful CLI evidence once, and preserve immutable x1 and all sibling lanes.
records.sibling_recommendation: Separate executable entrypoint success from Markdown layout checks and avoid replaying a successful command merely to repair the latter.

records.failed_witness: A combined builder-and-review shell exceeded its initial yield window after the builder succeeded, while the caller projected only command text and omitted the returned continuation handle.

records.recovery: Separate the bounded builder invocation from post-build review and always preserve the full process result whenever an ongoing session is possible.

records.rollback: Give the lost continuation projection zero credit and do not replay the already-successful builder solely to recover its omitted shell summary.
